# Dick Moore

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Glen  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Role:** Sailor and store clerk  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

He was a big, handsome fellow when young, possessing a striking eye peculiarity where one eye was blue and the other hazel. He had a lighter shade of hair compared to his double cousin George Moore, as well as higher facial color.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

He was an agreeable and pleasant man when things went well, but was plagued by a selfish, tyrannical soul and a bad temper. He was persistently persistent until he obtained what he desired, after which he lost interest. In his youth he drank a good deal.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)_

## Traits

- Handsome  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- Selfish  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- Tyrannical  <sub>[v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004)</sub>
- Heavy drinker  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Abilities

- Sailing  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Leslie West  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## History

Dick Moore grew up in the Glen working in his father's store during winters and sailing during summers. He became obsessed with marrying Leslie West, though she snubbed his advances. When his father held a mortgage over the West farm, Dick threatened Leslie's mother Rose with foreclosure until Rose pressured Leslie into marrying him. Following their marriage, Dick lived with Leslie and her mother on the West farm for a single winter. After Rose died in the spring, Dick grew tired of settled married life and went to Nova Scotia before embarking on a voyage to Havana on the Four Sisters. While in Cuba, Dick caught yellow fever and died thirteen years prior to the events at Four Winds, though for twelve years his family and community mistakenly believed his cousin George Moore—who suffered an brain injury and loss of identity—was Dick.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)_

## Background by volume

- Son of Abner Moore who kept store at the Glen  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- Had a sea-going streak inherited from his mother  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- Double cousin of George Moore of Nova Scotia  <sub>[v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>
